name: Procrea Holdings, Inc.
summary: Procrea Holdings, Inc. operates as a holding company for the Aomori Michinoku Bank, Ltd. that provides banking products and services in Japan. The company operates through two segments, Banking and Leasing. The company's financial services include deposits, lending, trading of commodity securities, securities investment, and foreign exchange, as well as corporate bond underwriting and registration services, and related services. It also offers credit cards, credit guarantees, and debt management and collection businesses; and consulting, leasing, and real estate management and leasing services.
